description: A poster printed on the same heavy, scorch-edged stock as the one it was torn from. Cyd stands with one boot up on a dead industrial generator the size of a coffin, forearm resting across her knee, utterly unhurried while the skyline behind her browns out floor by floor. A single heavy cable runs from the machine off the left edge of the frame — cut clean, as though it once continued somewhere. CYD — SHE DECIDES WHEN THE POWER COMES BACK. Stencilled beneath in utility-company type: "blackout or dawn, it's her hand on the breaker, and she is in no hurry to tell you which one you've earned." A real length of copper wire, worried bright by passing thumbs, is threaded through two punched holes along the torn left edge.
name: hero poster: CYD, THE HAND ON THE BREAKER
